worldcombat.skill.supersonic.summary: Pushes a ring of sound out from the body, sweeping the ground all around; anything the wave front crosses is left confused, so its actions may be wasted and its own force turns on it. The pulse is not aimed and passes through walls — running out of the front is the safe play.
worldcombat.skill.supersonic.use.0: Disrupt a whole circle when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.supersonic.use.1: Push back several targets that crowd the user
worldcombat.skill.supersonic.use.2: Open a collective miss window in a brawl
worldcombat.skill.supersonic.description: The pulse expands from the user, base radius %1$s blocks (scaled by form and clamped to 4-14 blocks), the front advancing %2$s blocks per tick; any non-ally the front passes over is caught, and walls do not block it.

Caught non-allies are left confused for a base %1$s (further scaled by form): each attempt has about a 30%% chance to be wasted (about 40%% in Focus form); when it lands a hit on an enemy it takes backlash for about 5.5%% of its maximum health, multiplied by 0.4-2.5 by its Attack.

Pushing out the pulse takes %1$s, the recovery %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. Wide form: radius x1.3, but confusion duration x0.8 and a 30%% fumble chance; Focus form: radius x0.7 and cooldown x1.1, buying confusion duration x1.3 and a 40%% fumble chance.
Wide: radius x1.3 for broader coverage, but confusion duration x0.8 and a 30%% fumble chance — good for an opening when surrounded. Focus: radius x0.7 and cooldown x1.1, buying x1.3 confusion duration and a 40%% fumble chance — good for dazing one target at close range.
The partner only considers the pulse while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee range, larger lets it chase out.
When swarmed: sound only with at least two enemies close, or right after the partner is hit. Anytime: sound on a single threat as pure disruption.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to sound.
worldcombat.skill.supersonic.description: The confusion ends when it expires or is cleansed; a target warded by protection effects never takes it, so neither the fumble nor the backlash occurs.
